content_html.en:
I'm E. Van Aubel

I'm a backend developer who grew up between two worlds: born in Amsterdam, raised partly in Indonesia. That journey taught me more than just a second language. It gave me a different way of seeing things. I build things on the server side, and I've also dipped my toes into security work. What really drives me isn't just the code, it's solving real problems, together with people. I listen well, and that matters more than most technical skills. I'm endlessly curious, especially about cybersecurity. In a world where everything's connected, protecting it feels like one of the most important jobs out there. And I'm not afraid to keep learning because I never want to stop growing. Currently, I'm on the lookout for my next role where I can contribute meaningfully and continue developing my craft. I'm also focused on building a stable life alongside my girlfriend, whose unwavering support means everything to me.

Ik ben E. Van Aubel

E. Van Aubel is een student softwareontwikkeling die bang is voor CSS en in Amsterdam woont. Ze zijn gepassioneerd over vrije en open-source software en privacy-pleitbezorging. Hun vaardigheden omvatten programmeren in Python en JavaScript, webontwikkeling met CSS en HTML, en vaardigheid in het Laravel-framework en Tailwind CSS. In hun vrije tijd geniet E. Van Aubel van films, anime en muziek.
